items.title: Your CFO wants SAP AI results next quarter – here’s where to start
items.summary: The challenge Last month, I sat down with a CIO for a manufacturing company in Johannesburg. He stopped me mid-sentence: “Please don’t say ‘AI transformation’, I’ve heard it forty times this quarter. Just tell me one thing I can actually implement before my board meeting in six weeks.” He’s not alone. Every SAP leader I […]
